n: MIT App Inventor AI tutorials and curriculum (PICaboo)
t: A two-part tutorial where students train an image classifier and build a peekaboo app.
steps: Find the PICaboo tutorial on the App Inventor site.
Open App Inventor in a browser.
Train a model at the PIC site.
Gather Android devices with cameras for part two.
Check that no webcam images are saved without a plan.
